plugins.Author: Legends of the Game
plugins.Name: Time Memoria
plugins.Description: Quest progression and pacing — a reflective notebook for your story journey, not a scoreboard.
plugins.Punchline: Remember every step, Warriors of Light.
plugins.Changelog:
New: /tm <expansion> (arr, hw, sb/stb, shb, ew, dt, ec) opens a list of every unfinished quest in that expansion at once, instead of browsing one category at a time.
- Shows a message instead of a blank list when there's nothing left: congratulations if it's done, or a note that the expansion hasn't released yet.
Fixed: Patch 7.5's Main Scenario finish line now points to the quest 7.56 actually continued the story to (Windborne), not the placeholder set before 7.56 shipped.
